consequence.statement: The rejected-update metric is now published as `envoy_cilium_npds_update_rejected` instead of `envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_rejected`.
consequence.remediation: Change any monitoring queries, dashboards or alerts that use the old metric name to use `envoy_cilium_npds_update_rejected`.

assertion.statement: In Cilium 1.17 the Envoy metric `envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_rejected` was renamed to `envoy_cilium_npds_update_rejected`.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: The subject is a Prometheus metric name, and none of the subject families covers metrics.; change: This is a rename, but 'renamed' needs a replacedBy in the same family, and metrics have no family.; applicability: Exposure depends on outside dashboards, alerts or queries that use the old metric name. No configuration predicate reads those, and the evidence gives no condition.
